content: माध्यंदिन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) .²1 Mid-day, meridional. .²2 Middle, central. .{@-नः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a branch of Vājasaneyins. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of an astronomical school which fixed the starting point of planetary movements at noon. .{@-नम्@} A branch of the शुक्ल or white Yajurveda (followed by the Mādhyandinas).
